name: Link-U Group Inc.
summary: Link-U Group Inc. operates in the internet service business in Japan, developing and running manga apps. It also provides marketing services, promotion planning and consulting using Vtubers and streamers, and DX introduction support covering fields from manga apps to government systems, and operates Bookhodai, a manga and magazine service. Formerly Link-U Inc., it was renamed in 2024 and has its head office in Chiyoda, Japan.
